third_party_auth_sdk_introduced.question: Did we introduce Firebase, Auth0, Supabase, Clerk, or Cognito SDKs?
third_party_auth_sdk_introduced.rationale: Reused existing backend FastAPI session and OAuth infrastructure directly over standard HTTP and platform system browser handoffs.

refresh_token_machinery_overbuilt.question: Did we build complex refresh token retry queues or token rotation interceptors?
refresh_token_machinery_overbuilt.rationale: Used straightforward session tokens with server-side TTL and clean 401 handling.

account_repository_hierarchy_bloat.question: Did we introduce unnecessary repository interfaces, domain interactors, and multi-layered DTO mappers?
account_repository_hierarchy_bloat.rationale: Kept a single focused AuthRepository per platform with direct StateFlow / @Observable state exposure.

m14_local_data_binding.question: Did we bind M14 Room/SwiftData tables to user IDs?
m14_local_data_binding.rationale: Maintained strict local device ownership. Local data is completely independent of user identity.

local_features_gated.question: Did we gate any core feature behind authentication?
local_features_gated.rationale: Every feature remains 100% accessible signed out.

overbuilt_future_sync.question: Did we write speculative sync engines or mock sync queues?
overbuilt_future_sync.rationale: Cross-device sync is explicitly marked DEFERRED / NOT IMPLEMENTED.

action_classifications.element: Backend Google OAuth redirect parameter passing via HMAC cookie
action_classifications.reason: Reuses existing cookie infrastructure with zero new dependencies.

action_classifications.element: Single-use 60s auth ticket cache in AuthRoutes
action_classifications.reason: Simplest secure browser-to-app credential handoff mechanism.
Standard Android Keystore security without heavyweight crypto libraries.
Native Security framework call, zero third-party Pods/SPMs.
